# crosswork_gnmi_settings (Data Source)

This data source can read the gNMI alarm collection of the vendors.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_gnmi_settings" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `cisco_systems` (Boolean) Enable gNMI for Cisco Systems
- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `juniper_networks` (Boolean) Enable gNMI for Juniper Networks
